{"id":1032198605,"question_id":42,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 11 months","timestamp":1693049160,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"95 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1032198605/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trapping Rain Water","memory":"43.3 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int Trap(int[] height) {\n        int water = 0;\n        int n = height.Length;\n        int[] leftMaxSum = new int[n];\n        leftMaxSum[0]= height[0];\n\n        for(int i = 1; i < n; i++)\n        {\n            leftMaxSum[i] = Math.Max(leftMaxSum[i-1],height[i]);\n        }\n\n        int[] rightMaxSum = new int[n];\n        rightMaxSum[n-1]= height[n-1];\n\n        for(int i = n-2; i >= 0; i--)\n        {\n            rightMaxSum[i] = Math.Max(rightMaxSum[i+1],height[i]);\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)\n        {\n            water += Math.Min(leftMaxSum[i], rightMaxSum[i]) - height[i];\n        }\n\n        return water;\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trapping-rain-water","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":21}
